Subject: Request: high-level pen test briefing and sanitized executive summary for upcoming audit

Hi Lauren,

We're preparing for a scheduled regulatory audit next month and the audit team requested a high-level penetration testing executive summary and a short status of remediations for controls that map to their scope (network segmentation, data encryption, auth flows). Could Redwood provide a sanitized executive summary of the most recent pen test and a one-page remediation/status snapshot?

We understand that full reports are sensitive — we're happy to sign an NDA and accept a redacted/sanitized exec summary. We will only use it within the audit team and can provide the auditor contact if you prefer direct streaming to a secure viewer.

Requested timeline: can you share something before 2027-04-18? Also please confirm what categories of information you will redact (hosts, customer identifiers, PoCs, logs, etc.).

Thanks,
Elsa Moreno
Senior IT Audit Manager
Kinetic Bank
elsa@kineticbank.com

Team — looping you in. Kinetic (Elsa) asked for a sanitized exec summary + remediation snapshot for an audit, wants delivery by 4/18. They offered to sign an NDA.

Key questions for us:
- What redaction categories are mandatory vs optional?
- Can we provide a watermarked secure-viewer copy (48h TTL) that includes the exec summary + remediation matrix?
- Do we need to provide any sampled evidence or is a summarized remediation status sufficient for the audit team?

I propose:

- Attach a remediation matrix (status, PR links to fixes, ETA)
- Require a mutually signed NDA before giving viewer access; evidence beyond the exec summary goes to secure viewer with time-limited links and watermarking; full report is only for in-person review under a tighter SOW.

If legal signs off on the NDA language and redaction categories, I can reply to Elsa with the DocuSign link and the secure viewer link stub.

— Lauren

Agree with Lauren's approach. From legal's perspective, here's the minimal path to get them what they need while protecting Redwood and our customers:

Redaction categories (recommended minimum):
- Customer identifiers (IDs, account numbers, tenant names) — always redact
- Hostnames/IPs and internal network diagrams — redact or replace with abstracted architecture diagrams
- Exploit PoCs or scripts — never share outside a controlled viewer and only as heavily redacted excerpts if at all
- Authentication tokens, keys, and secrets — redact
- PII and any customer data — redact per privacy policy

Sharing options:
- Executive summary (PDF) — sanitized, watermark, can be emailed once DocuSign NDA is complete.
- Remediation matrix (spreadsheet) — sanitized, includes ticket IDs (internal), short status, ETA. No raw logs.
- Secure viewer access — temporary link (48–72 hours), IP-restricted if needed; viewer session logged and watermarked. Evidence beyond the summary (screenshots, logs) can be made available in the secure viewer only.

NDA: I'll attach NDA language and a short addendum that limits reuse for audits and forbids further disclosure. We should require sign-off from Kinetic's legal before enabling secure viewer.

Please prepare the sanitized exec summary and a remediation sheet draft; security (Marissa) should advise on what to redact in the remediation matrix (ticket notes vs. sanitized description). I'll route the NDA to their signatory via DocuSign.

— Jonas
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the request and for offering to sign an NDA. We've prepared a proposed path forward that should meet audit needs while protecting sensitive info. Summary below and next steps at the end.

What we'll provide:
- Redwood_PenTest_Sanitized_ExecSummary_v1.pdf — one-page executive summary with high-level findings and classifications (Critical/High/Medium/Low). All customer identifiers, hostnames, PoC artifacts, and PII have been removed/abstracted.
- Remediation_Matrix_20270411.xlsx — one-sheet matrix listing issue id (sanitized), impact, remediation status, remediation owner, and ETA. Internal ticket links are internal-only and not included; where helpful we include an internal reference id that the auditor can reference to Kinetic's internal records.

Access & controls:
- NDA: Jonas has prepared NDA_Redwood-KineticBank_20270411.docx; we will send this via DocuSign. Please have your legal sign and return — once completed we'll enable viewer access. (DocuSign link: https://docusign.example.com/RW-KTN-20270411)

Timeline:
- Today: send NDA via DocuSign (Jonas) and attach sanitized exec summary + remediation matrix as a provisional copy.
- Once signed (expected 1–3 business days): enable secure viewer and provide time-limited access.
- If auditor requests artifacts: we will scope and provide via viewer within 3 business days after NDA sign-off.

Next steps for you:

2) Confirm whether the auditor will access via the secure viewer link or whether you prefer we share the sanitized PDF directly by email after NDA execution.

Best,
